name: imx636_tuned
description: IMX636 with tuned (low-threshold) biases, S16 case m636_tuned: C_on 0.10, BA 1 Hz.

threshold.C_off.uncertainty: OFF threshold at tuned biases not published

ba.rate_hz.uncertainty: 1-3.5; [T] Sect. 3.2 p. 17: 3197 kev/s (3.5 ev/s/px) for bias set IMX-6 and 1887 kev/s (2.0 ev/s/px) for IMX-7, monitor off; IMX-6 is the McReynolds low-light bias set ([T] Table 3.2, p. 15)

hot.fraction.uncertainty: 0.5-5%; [T] Fig. 3.2c-f (p. 18) shows a broad per-pixel tail at the same low-light bias set (IMX-6/IMX-7) that needs a 1% mask
hot.fraction.source: McReynolds et al. 2025 (~2% hot pixels at tuned biases); consistent with [T] Fig. 3.2c-f

events.refractory_s.uncertainty: longer than default: the low-light bias set uses bias_refr = -20 ([T] Table 3.2 p. 15; Table 2.1 p. 9: increasing bias_refr shortens the refractory period); absolute value not published
events.refractory_s.note: conflicts with the proposed requirement refractory <= 10 us (V6) unless bias_refr is reset; flagged for the team
